{{Quote|Finest speeders on Bespin! You can trust me, I'm Honest Grek.|Honest Grek|<ref name="The Jewel of Yavin">''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]''</ref>}}
'''Honest Grek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and the owner of [[Honest Grek's Speeders]], selling [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] or [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He and [[Merl Terll]] were partners in the [[Cloud City Grand Prix/Legends|Cloud City Grand Prix]] before an accident, ending their relationship when Merl refused to race again at the request of his [[Babs Terll|wife]].
